about.summary: Most price indexes are made with a two-step procedure, where period-over-period elementary indexes are first calculated for a collection of elementary aggregates at each point in time, and then aggregated according to a price index aggregation structure. These indexes can then be chained together to form a time series that gives the evolution of prices with respect to a fixed base period. This package contains a collection of functions that revolve around this work flow, making it easy to build standard price indexes, and implement the methods described by Balk (2008, <doi:10.1017/CBO9780511720758>), von der Lippe (2007, <doi:10.3726/978-3-653-01120-3>), and the CPI manual (2020, <doi:10.5089/9781484354841.069>) and PPI manual (2004, <doi:10.5089/9781589063044.069>) for bilateral price indexes.

Most price indexes are made with a two-step procedure, where period-over-period elementary indexes are first calculated for a collection of elementary aggregates at each point in time, and then aggregated according to a price index aggregation structure. These indexes can then be chained together to form a time series that gives the evolution of prices with respect to a fixed base period. This package contains a collection of functions that revolve around this work flow, making it easy to build standard price indexes, and implement the methods described by Balk (2008, <doi:10.1017/CBO9780511720758>), von der Lippe (2007, <doi:10.3726/978-3-653-01120-3>), and the CPI manual (2020, <doi:10.5089/9781484354841.069>) and PPI manual (2004, <doi:10.5089/9781589063044.069>) for bilateral price indexes.

name: r-piar
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "0.11.0" %}
{% set posix = 'm2-' if win else '' %}

package:
  name: r-piar
  version: {{ version|replace("-", "_") }}

source:
  url:
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/piar_{{ version }}.tar.gz
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/Archive/piar/piar_{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: d66599135f2f2cb2fcdba714253ee38b286370475662a65827e5c195c1c199d0

build:
  number: 1
  noarch: generic
  rpaths:
    - lib/R/lib/
    - lib/

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ posix }}zip               # [win]
    - cross-r-base {{ r_base }}    # [build_platform != target_platform]
  host:
    - r-base
    - r-matrix >=1.5_0
  run:
    - r-base
    - r-matrix >=1.5_0

test:
  commands:
    - $R -e "library('piar')"           # [not win]
    - "\"%R%\" -e \"library('piar')\""  # [win]

about:
  home: https://codeberg.org/marberts/piar
  license: GPL-3.0-or-later
  summary: Most price indexes are made with a two-step procedure, where
    period-over-period elementary indexes are first calculated for a collection
    of elementary aggregates at each point in time, and then aggregated according
    to a price index aggregation structure. These indexes can then be chained
    together to form a time series that gives the evolution of prices with
    respect to a fixed base period. This package contains a collection of
    functions that revolve around this work flow, making it easy to build
    standard price indexes, and implement the methods described by
    Balk (2008, <doi:10.1017/CBO9780511720758>), von der Lippe (2007,
    <doi:10.3726/978-3-653-01120-3>), and the CPI manual (2020,
    <doi:10.5089/9781484354841.069>) and PPI manual
    (2004, <doi:10.5089/9781589063044.069>) for bilateral price indexes.
  license_family: GPL3
  license_file:
    - '{{ environ["PREFIX"] }}/lib/R/share/licenses/GPL-3'

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - conda-forge/r
    - marberts
